chapter: Kline 1980: early years and founding of the Goldkette orchestra
title: Playing with Ted Weems at Ocean City while in high school
summary: He played with Weems in Ocean City while still in high school, annoying the school band by taking too many solos; his father's lodges got him drumming jobs and he also took piano lessons.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Tell me about when you played with Ted Weems.
We used to go out and we'd march out, you know.
Remember how you used to go and play with him?
Was that after you were in high school or while you were still in high school?
After I was in high school.
While you were still in high school.
Because the guys that played in the high school band were unhappy with me.
Why? Why were they unhappy with you?
Oh. You mean they didn't get a chance to play enough. Is that it?
Did your father belong to lodges and they needed a drummer. Is that how you played?
So he got you a job playing for the lodges.
They bought him a nice set of drums and he started just drumming.
And you were also at the same time taking piano lessons?
